# VERIFICATION -- the physics oracle

This file is the **oracle**. Every number here is computed from first principles by
`scripts/derive.py`, independently of the simulator. The tests in `tests/physics/`
assert that the simulation reproduces them. **If these pass, the physics is right.**

Regenerate with `python scripts/derive.py`. `scripts/audit.ps1` fails if this file is stale.

## 1. Cell geometry, mass, and the buoyancy consequence

| Quantity | Value | Unit | Origin |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cell volume | `5.23599e-16` | m^3 | (4/3)pi r^3 |
| Dry density (canon mass) | `40.107` | kg/m^3 | **25x LIGHTER than water** -- see ADR-002 |
| Mass if water-density | `5.22656e-13` | kg | 0.523 ng vs canon 0.021 ng |
| Stored mass at 1.5 MJ | `1.66898e-11` | kg | E/c^2; canon says '~17 ng' |
| Full-cell density | `31915.2` | kg/m^3 | **32.0x water**, denser than osmium |
| Energy at neutral buoyancy | `45086.6` | J | (rho_w V - m_dry) c^2 |
| **Charge at neutral buoyancy** | `3.00577` | % | **P1: below this a cell rises, above it sinks** |

## 2. Drag, diffusion, and dynamic regime

| Quantity | Value | Unit | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Drag coefficient gamma(20 C) | `9.44122e-08` | kg/s | 6 pi mu a |
| Diffusivity D(20 C) | `4.28692e-14` | m^2/s | = `0.0429` um^2/s |
| RMS 2D displacement in 1 s (20 C) | `0.4141` | um | MSD = 4Dt |
| Diffusivity D(96.415 C) | `1.86782e-13` | m^2/s | = `0.1868` um^2/s |
| RMS 2D displacement in 1 s (96.415 C) | `0.8644` | um | **4.36x -- drives P4** |
| Momentum relaxation tau, empty | `2.22429e-07` | s | |
| Momentum relaxation tau, full | `0.000176998` | s | **796x spread -> OU integrator** |

The 800x mass spread between an empty and a full cell is why the integrator must be the
exact-propagator Ornstein-Uhlenbeck update and not a naive overdamped or Verlet scheme.
See `docs/PHYSICS.md` Sec 3.

## 4. Petrova emission and photon thrust

| Quantity | Value | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| Wavelength | `25.984` | um |
| Frequency | `11.538` | THz |
| Photon energy | `7.64488e-21` J = `0.04772` | eV |
| Photons in a full cell | `1.962e+26` | - |

| Emission power | Thrust F = P/c | Terminal velocity |
|---|---|---|
| `1.00` mW | `3.336e-12` N | `35.33` um/s |
| `10.00` mW | `3.336e-11` N | `353.31` um/s |
| `47.59` mW | `1.588e-10` N | `1681.47` um/s |

**`47.59` mW is exactly the power a fully charged cell needs to hover** against its own
weight. That is why `PETROVA_MAX_POWER` defaults to 50 mW (ADR-005).

## 5. Thermal behaviour (P2, P3)

Conduction coefficient `4 pi k a` = `3.75734e-05` W/K.

| Medium temperature | Heat loss Q | 1.5 MJ endurance |
|---|---|---|
| `20.0` C | `2.871` mW | `16.6` yr |
| `37.0` C | `2.232` mW | `21.3` yr |
| `90.0` C | `0.241` mW | `197.2` yr |
| `96.0` C | `0.016` mW | `3048.3` yr |

**Q -> 0 as the medium approaches the setpoint.** The medium asymptotes to 96.415 C and stops.
Since the setpoint is `3.585` K below water's boiling point, **a live culture can never boil its medium at 1 atm**. That is P2, and it is emergent -- do not special-case it.

Analytic near-field halo around an isolated cell, `T(r) = T_inf + dT a/r`:

| r | Excess temperature |
|---|---|
| 2a | `+38.2` K |
| 5a | `+15.3` K |
| 10a | `+7.6` K |
| 20a | `+3.8` K |

## 6. Field solver stability

Water thermal diffusivity alpha = `1.43252e-07` m^2/s.
Diffusion time across the default 4.0 mm chamber = `111.7` s -- fast, but not instantaneous, so a quasi-steady solve is wrong.

| Field | N | dx | Diffusivity | Explicit dt_max | Substeps per 1 ms |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FIELD_N_TEMP` | 512 | `7.81` um | `1.433e-07` m^2/s | `0.0001065` s | **10** |
| `FIELD_N_CO2` | 256 | `15.62` um | `1.92e-09` m^2/s | `0.03179` s | **1** |
| `FIELD_N_N2` | 128 | `31.25` um | `2e-09` m^2/s | `0.1221` s | **1** |

These substep counts are why the grids are sized as they are (ADR-008) and why the
sub-grid thermal halo is added analytically rather than resolved (ADR-010).

## 7. Microscope optics

| Objective | M | NA | Resolution | Depth of field | Field of view | Cell spans |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SURVEY | 10x | 0.25 | `1342` nm | `11.20` um | `2200` um | `7` resel |
| WORKING | 40x | 0.65 | `516` nm | `1.53` um | `550` um | `19` resel |
| DETAIL | 100x | 1.25 | `268` nm | `0.61` um | `220` um | `37` resel |

At the default WORKING objective the depth of field is `1.53` um inside a `60` um slab,
so most cells are visibly out of focus at any moment. Racking focus is a primary interaction, not a garnish.

## 8. Scale and the energy ledger

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| One full cell | `358.5` g TNT equivalent |
| 5,000 full cells | `7.50` GJ = `1.793` t TNT |
| Default population (25,000 cells), fully charged | `0.0` TJ = `9.0` kt TNT |
| Thermal blackbody peak at setpoint (Wien) | `7.841` um -- **distinct from the 25.984 um Petrova line** |
| Growth rate at 8 d doubling | `1.003e-06` /s |

The energy ledger is not a curiosity: the default population holds kiloton-scale energy inside a
droplet. The HUD carries this readout permanently (docs/RENDERING.md Sec 6).
